scope.coverage: exact exhaustive on listed prime-order toy curves, repetitions permitted
scope.search: randomized 8+8 point-list collision search, not a Semaev/PKC polynomial solver
scope.targets: uniform before solving, not sums planted in the factor base
scope.oracle: complete group enumeration used by coverage and validation, excluded from solver inputs; not a practical algorithm
scope.cost: counts actual add routine calls, incl precomputation and failed queries; not calibrated to field work or wall time
scope.timing: coverage_runtime is not claimed as relation-search runtime
scope.reference: BSGS solves DLP, not factorbase decomposition; separate generic cost reference
scope.limitations: small curves change D and arithmetic, not asymptotic evidence for secp256k1; no polynomial-solving degree measured
